SELECT t.userId, t.role, t.username, t.gender, t.phone, t.email, t.avatar, t.status, t.createTime FROM ( SELECT u.id AS userId, 1 AS role, u.username, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, c.status, c.create_time AS createTime, c.id AS accountId, u.deleted AS userDeleted, c.deleted AS accountDeleted FROM user u INNER JOIN customer c ON c.user_id = u.id UNION ALL SELECT u.id, 2, u.username, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, co.status, co.create_time, co.id, u.deleted, co.deleted FROM user u INNER JOIN courier co ON co.user_id = u.id UNION ALL SELECT u.id, 0, u.username, u.gender, u.phone, u.email, u.avatar, a.status, a.create_time, a.id, u.deleted, a.deleted FROM user u INNER JOIN admin a ON a.user_id = u.id ) t
AND (t.userDeleted != 0 OR t.accountDeleted != 0)
AND t.userDeleted = 0 AND t.accountDeleted = 0
AND t.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.username}, '%')
AND t.phone LIKE CONCAT(#{dto.phone}, '%')
AND t.email LIKE CONCAT(#{dto.email}, '%')
AND t.status = #{dto.userStatus}
ORDER BY t.createTime ASC, t.accountId ASC
ORDER BY t.createTime DESC, t.accountId DESC
